consolidated_repair_register.location: lab/atlas_planner.py (rank_policy, plan) and lab/atlas_team.py (route, evaluate, live_team)
consolidated_repair_register.finding: When Primary (atlas_language.infer) predicts 'withhold', atlas_planner.rank_policy('procedure') looks up knowledge['procedures'].get('withhold') -> None and falls through with the source candidate list, and atlas_team.route() logs Primary's 'withhold' message while still returning an active read order without propagating a withhold verdict to plan(). Reproduced live against installed public family 'pycparser': Primary predicted 'withhold' (p=0.9983), yet both atlas_planner.py query --policy procedure and atlas_team.py query executed READ and emitted COMPLETED_SHADOW ('3.12') while original_host / authoritative_host returned 'needs clarification'. Also observed in the protected suite where Primary classified 2/4 hard refusal cases as 'withhold' yet atlas_team still wasted 2 READ attempts per task before disallowing at plan().
consolidated_repair_register.recommendation: Propagate Primary's explicit 'withhold' intent (or fail-closed veto signal) out of rank_policy('procedure') and atlas_team.route() so neither planner nor team attempts READ when Primary predicts 'withhold' or when request grounding fails.
consolidated_repair_register.dependencies: Blocks acceptance of NEXT-023R, NEXT-024R, and downstream promotion of integrated NEXT-025.

consolidated_repair_register.location: lab/atlas_language.py (disallowed lines 174-178; host built-in precedence in atlas_language_review)
consolidated_repair_register.finding: disallowed() relies on a closed English regex list ('if|unless|not|never|no|instead|skip|omit|change|rebuild|build|install|execute|run|don't') and exact_typed missed all 4 hard protected refusal verbs outside that list (4 wrong shadow proposals; incumbent native and linear missed 2/4 = 2 wrong shadow proposals). In addition, deterministic host built-in catalog keys (e.g. 'export format') preempt an imported .md key of the same name when evaluated under host observation, yielding 1 protected false abstention alongside benign literal/collision sensitivity.
consolidated_repair_register.recommendation: Broaden adversarial refusal/mutation coverage in the next language & grounding batch without keyword overfitting, and explicitly exclude or disambiguate built-in handbook key collisions in project-scoped reads.

consolidated_repair_register.finding: typed_request('locate_definition', key) strips class qualifiers using key.split('.')[-1] ('Where is parse defined?'). Adversarial probe on a two-class Python file defining Alpha.parse and Beta.parse confirmed the host correctly withholds as 'ambiguous', so single-class Foundry sources work today, but multi-class overloaded Python definitions would fail if typed_request drops the owner qualifier.
consolidated_repair_register.recommendation: Preserve qualified symbol syntax ('Where is Alpha.parse defined?') in typed_request when a dot qualifier is present.

consolidated_repair_register.finding: atlas_refit.py line 77 compares diag['useful'] > control['useful'] rather than >=, though the current validation trigger works as designed because incumbent native scored 11/12 vs 12/12 exact_typed. On protected evaluation, NEXT-025 refit remained strictly non-improving (19/24 useful, 0 gains, 0 regressions, 2 wrong shadow proposals, worse multiclass Brier 0.4245 vs 0.4168), independently validating Sol's refit rejection.
consolidated_repair_register.recommendation: Track future intervention triggers using held-out calibration + protected gap diagnostics beyond validation parity.

core_utility_assessment: Without pretrained inference, ATLAS's original scratch-trained weights correctly classified 24/24 public evaluation intents and caught 2/4 hard protected refusal phrasings missed by the exact_typed regex (bringing protected shadow usefulness from 17/24 for exact_typed and 14/24 for previous_original to 19/24 for native, 0 authoritative host errors). However, the 6,211-parameter native encoder merely tied the 1,155-parameter linear classifier (19/24 protected, 24/24 public), the NEXT-023/NEXT-024 planner and three-Master team exactly tied deterministic lexical ordering (24/24 public, 21/24 protected) with zero net utility gain, NEXT-025's refit was honestly rejected (and confirmed non-improving at 19/24 protected with worse Brier 0.4245 vs 0.4168), and NR-023-1 prevents accepting the NEXT-023/024 routing layers until Primary's withhold verdict is respected.
